Read the dictionary entry.

plateau \ pla-ˈtō \ n
1. a large flat area of land that is higher than the land surrounding it 2. a period or state of no increase or decline 3. a period of little or no progress in a person’s learning 4. a level of achievement

Which definition best matches the use of the word plateau in paragraph 5?
